note: Sentinel assets for active asset capability verification and Asset Data Quorum v1. Each sentinel must be a cheap, public, permanent query on mainnet: an asset name, an optional qualifier for tag history, an optional restricted asset name, and an optional one-character prefix for get_assets_with_prefix. Never create assets or spend RVN for monitoring. An empty list (the shipped default) cleanly disables active asset probing: capability falls back to the server.features flag and asset quorum reports INSUFFICIENT_QUORUM instead of fabricating samples.
